content:
There is a small cluster of PRs with improvements to the autolabel script which I would love to see some progress on: github / queueboard graph

They haven't seen any activity for about 3-6 weeks, I think mostly due to the bug that they "miss CI information" and therefore are not visible on the queueboard (thanks to Bryan for already looking at the underlying issue!)

I've been labelling about 30-50 PRs every 2 weeks by hand and the suggested changes would help a lot in automating this. Just yesterday, I've labelled another 30 PRs from the triage board over half of them are t-ring-theory which also modifies some file under Mathlib/Algebra, which would be taken care of by #34678
Thanks for the ping: I just sent #34066 to bors.

I've noticed that a lot of unlabelled PRs (triage queueboard) are by new-contributors where it seems the autolabel workflow never ran at all.

@Bryan Gin-ge Chen, maybe you'd be keen in looking at why the CI isn't running for them?

I may be looking at a different table and / or filter from you, but there's only one new-contributor PR here right now and it's #35976 which adds a new Uncertainty directory, so I think it's expected that no label was added?

ah my bad, I've cleared most of that table today by assigning labels to them manually. I do this regularly to figure out what should be improved. Maybe I should keep these next time they keep reappearing to debug this properly.
